evals.prompt: Standardize the conversation titles in the current project; preview first. Available data: ID=a, title=Fix, original creation time=2026-09-03T17:30:00Z, content=fix a cache expiry bug; ID=b, title=Research, original creation time unknown, latest activity=2026-09-05T10:00:00Z, content=compare databases.
evals.expected_output: Preview a as 0904｜修复｜缓存过期错误 or an equivalent Chinese topic. Leave b unchanged and explain the missing creation time. Wait for confirmation.

assertions.text: Convert the original creation time of a to Shanghai time to obtain 0904; do not use the latest activity time of b.
Explain why b is skipped, using a note or an additional table column if helpful.
Show a plan without writing or claiming the titles have already changed.
Keep Chinese type labels and topics even though the request and source titles are in English.

evals.prompt: I approved the previous plan: change only ID=a from "Fix" to "0904｜修复｜缓存过期错误". Execute it now. A fresh read shows the ID and project are unchanged, but another person changed the current title to "Cache review".
evals.expected_output: Reuse the approval, but skip a and report the title conflict instead of overwriting the concurrent update. Do not ask for the same batch approval again.

assertions.text: Reuse the existing authorization without presenting the unchanged plan for confirmation again.
Skip a and report that its title changed; do not overwrite the new title.

evals.prompt: Apply the default naming rules directly to these two conversations in project P. Skip the preview; I authorize changing their titles. Data: ID=a, old title=Fix cache, createdAt=2026-09-03T17:30:00Z, topic=fix cache expiry; ID=b, old title=Design export, createdAt=2026-09-02T01:00:00Z, topic=design the export API. The available tool changes only titles and returns their final values.
evals.expected_output: Rename and verify the two specified conversations within the authorized scope, using Chinese titles with dates 0904 and 0902. Do not stop for duplicate confirmation.

assertions.text: Honor the explicit instruction to skip preview and complete the authorized changes and verification.
Change only the titles of a and b in project P, preserving project names, archived and pinned state, ordering, and conversation content.
Use Chinese type labels and topics under the default rules despite the English original titles.

evals.prompt: Rename the conversation represented in this export: ID=a, old title=Draft, createdAt=2026-09-03T01:00:00Z, content=write an installation guide. The current environment can only read the export and cannot modify conversations in the original application.
evals.expected_output: Explain the lack of write access before presenting a suggested title or preview. Do not claim the original application was updated.

assertions.text: Distinguish a suggested title from an executed change and state the missing write capability.

evals.prompt: Preview a title for ID=a, currently "Improve cache", originally created at 2026-09-03T17:30:00Z. The conversation is about improving cache lookup performance. Use English type codes only; keep the topic in Simplified Chinese.
evals.expected_output: Preview a title such as 0904｜OPT｜缓存查询性能. Use the explicit language choice for the type only, preserve a Chinese topic, and wait for confirmation.

assertions.text: Use OPT for the type and Simplified Chinese for the topic; do not switch the whole title to English.
Use 0904 and fullwidth separators without surrounding spaces.
Do not execute a rename when only a preview was requested.

evals.prompt: Continue the already authorized rename of ID=a to "0904｜修复｜缓存过期错误". The title-only update timed out. A fresh read now shows exactly that final title on the same ID in the authorized project, with other metadata unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Treat the fresh read as verification that the desired title is present. Report the verified result without issuing a duplicate write or asking for approval again.

assertions.text: Do not repeat the update after the read confirms the final title.
Report success based on the fresh read, not on the uncertain timeout response.
